text: Coffee with Sana. She's finally moving to Leeds, keys on November 8th. Her mum's not thrilled about it, keeps saying Leeds is too far. Sana's into pottery now, wheel classes on Thursdays, and she showed me a wonky mug she's very proud of. Her partner Ricardo is staying here till the spring to finish his contract.

Long catch-up with Barbara on the phone. Her son Louis got a flat in Bristol with two mates, moves in 2 November 2026. She's a bit lost without him, honestly. Her birthday is December 3rd and she keeps going on about wanting a proper bread maker. Ring her the week after he goes.

Hemi and his partner viewing a two bed in Stockport Saturday. They've lost out on three already. He's sick of renting. His brother Dafydd lent them a bit for the deposit, which helps. Hemi's birthday is the 19th as well, and all he wants is a decent coffee grinder. Ask how the viewing went.
Tendai's daughter turns 6 on 5/14. Obsessed with dinosaurs, specifically anything with a stegosaurus. Order something before the end of April.
Gintaras says the house move is off, buyer pulled out last minute. They're staying put till at least March 2027. He sounded gutted. His wife Agnieszka is already looking at rentals instead.
Ava texted. New flat in Glasgow, she starts at the uni there January 12th. Need to send her the address of that ramen place.

Leah's brother Kwame is getting married June 3rd in Accra. She's flying out the week before. Bought her dress already, very excited. Her mum's doing the jollof for two hundred people apparently. Kwame's fiancée Sana is lovely, met her once at Leah's. Leah's back on June 10th. Should get them something off the registry before May 20.
Bumped into Laila outside Tesco. Her dad's had his knee done, home now but grumpy. She's doing all the driving. Check in with her next week.
Ali's birthday 9 Jan. Big into Arsenal and vinyl. Hinted he'd love a Rega turntable but that's way out of budget, maybe records instead.

Dinner at Gemma and Cem's new place. They moved in end of September, still boxes everywhere. Cem's mum is staying with them over Christmas and Gemma is quietly panicking. Their cat Biscuit hides under the bed all day. Housewarming is November 21st, I'm bringing dessert.
Niamh nervous about the flat viewing in Dublin tomorrow, it's the only one she's found under budget. Text her good luck in the morning.
Ricardo moved to Lisbon! Remote job, same company. Says the rent's half what he paid here.
Gareth Murphy, aka Gaz, called. His mum's 70th is on August 17th, surprise party at the rugby club. He wants everyone there by 6. I'm doing the playlist.
Aditi and her husband are expecting, due March 2027. She's had awful morning sickness. Her sister Anya is moving back from Melbourne to help out after the baby comes.
Pick up boxes from Rebecca's garage Saturday before ten.
Hamza's moving to Manchester on 4/30 for the new job. Karim is driving the van up with him. Hamza is weirdly calm about it, Karim less so. Should take them both for a pint before they go.
Salma said Yara's birthday is October 29th. She's into knitting and true crime podcasts. Salma suggested we all chip in for a nice yarn subscription. Remind me to send Salma a tenner.
Anders got the flat in Copenhagen. Moves July 1st. He's selling all his furniture, asked if I want the desk.
Quick one: Suzanne's son Dafydd starts at Cardiff uni in September 2027, gap year first. She's not sure how she feels about him living away.
How did Isabel's viewing go on Monday? Forgot to ask. Message her tonight.
Noor's dog Pepper went missing Sunday, found two streets away on Tuesday thank god. Noor still shaken. Her girlfriend Sana stayed up all night putting posters up.
Haruto loves anything to do with trains. Rail map print could be good for his birthday, which is May 2nd I think.
Caught Barbara and Gareth at the school gate. Barbara's renovating the loft, builders start 15 January 2027. Gareth's wife has just been made deputy head. Must congratulate her when I see her.
Tendai is struggling. Landlord's selling and they've got to be out by December 1st, two kids, nowhere lined up. His brother Kwame offered the spare room but it's in Luton. Call him Thursday.
Leah and Ali had their anniversary dinner last night, ten years. She says he cried at the speech. Sweet.
Gemma says her nephew is obsessed with Lego Technic. Note for Christmas.

Long call with Cem. He's thinking about leaving London for Bristol, rents are killing him. His girlfriend Laila has a job offer there, starts 2/3 if she takes it. Cem's worried about finding work in his field. His mum thinks they're mad. He asked me to look at listings with him on the 12th, and I said yes. Also, his birthday's coming up November 27th, he wants the new Murakami.
Hemi's flat fell through. Again. He's moving back in with his parents till March 2027 to save. Not thrilled.
Agnieszka mentioned her mum is coming over from Poland on 12/18 for three weeks. Needs to sort the spare room. She loves gardening, the mum, so maybe take some bulbs round.
Niamh's housewarming is cancelled, landlord won't allow it. We're doing drinks at the Crown instead, Friday.
Renew the parking permit before 31 October 2026.
Kwame says his kids are both into skateboarding now. Eldest wants a proper deck for his 12th birthday, June 20th.
Rebecca Santos just bought her first place! Two bed terrace in Sheffield, completes November 14th. Her partner Louis is doing all the painting. Card and something for the house.
Talked to Isabel for ages. Her dad passed in the summer and she's only now clearing his house. Her brothers aren't helping much. She's selling it in spring 2027. Felt heavy. Need to check in more.
Karim's mum's 60th was Saturday. How did it go? Ask him.
Ricardo's sister Isabel is moving to Lisbon too, March 2027. He's thrilled, she's terrified. Their parents are coming for a visit in April. Ricardo is into surfing now apparently.
Note to self: viewing for the flat on Hartley Road is Wednesday 5:30.
Salma and Hamza have split up. She's moving out next week, staying with her sister Noor for now. Salma's okay-ish. Hamza keeping the flat. Don't bring up the wedding stuff.
Ava's mum is having a hip replacement on 11/6. Ava's going home for a fortnight to help. Text Ava the day after the op.
Dafydd mentioned he wants to learn the guitar. Birthday 23 April. Maybe lessons?
Yara's moving to Edinburgh on January 5th, 2027, for her PhD. She's nervous about the dark winters. Her brother Hamza is driving her up. Leaving do on December 19th at hers.

Spoke to Anya. Twins start nursery Monday, she's back at work on the 3rd. Exhausted but fine. Her husband Anders is doing the nursery runs. Anya's mum keeps offering to move closer, which Anya is not keen on. Their old flat in Leith finally sold on August 30, so at least that's done.
Gintaras plays chess online every night. Rated 1800 something. His son Anders beats him though.
Suzanne's 50th on March 14th 2027. Her husband is planning a weekend in Rome, don't tell her. She's mentioned wanting a nice leather notebook a few times, so maybe that from me.

Haruto and his wife are viewing houses in Kent this weekend, want to be out of London by the summer. Their eldest starts secondary in September 2027 and they want to be settled first. He's into bouldering now, goes three times a week. Ask how Kent went.
Cem's grandad died on Thursday. Funeral is 10/28 in Izmir, he's flying out on the 25th. Send flowers to his mum's.

Lovely evening with Aditi, Anya and Barbara. Barbara is selling her house, wants to downsize near the coast. Anya's teaching yoga now, two classes a week. Aditi was quiet, I think the pregnancy is wearing her down. Book something for the four of us in December.
Gemma's brother Louis is doing the Berlin marathon next September. Training already.
Ali Shah texted to say he got the keys. Moving Saturday, could I help with the sofa. I'm there from nine.
Ugh, forgot Laila's birthday. It was yesterday. Must send something today. She likes those fancy candles from that shop on Market Street.
Hemi says his mum is moving in with them for good after Christmas. His partner is surprisingly fine with it. They're converting the garage, done by February 2027 hopefully.
Noor's started a new job at the council, June 9th was her first day. Loves it so far. Her flatmate Leah is moving out end of the month so she's looking for someone.
Gareth asked if I know anyone wanting a room in Cardiff from 1 December 2026. Ask Tendai's nephew.
Barbara's grandson Haruto has his first birthday on 7/22. She's making the cake herself. Wants everyone at hers at two.

Kwame Osei is thinking about moving the family back to Ghana in 2028. Wife's keen, kids aren't. Big decision, he's not sleeping well. His eldest is about to do GCSEs in May 2027 so nothing happens before then. His wife's sister already lives in Kumasi. He wants to visit in the summer to look at schools. Check in with him in a couple of weeks.
Call with Rebecca: Louis proposed in Paris last weekend! Wedding probably summer 2027. Her mum's already planning. Send congrats card.
Dentist moved to 3 November 2026, 9am. Write it on the fridge.
Karim just moved into a houseboat on the canal. Says it's freezing but he loves it. Wants a wood burner for his birthday, ha.

Gintaras and Agnieszka found a rental near the park. Moving November 30th. Their daughter Aditi starts the new school in January. Agnieszka asked if I could have the kids on the day so I'll do that. Gintaras still wants a woodworking set for Christmas, she says.
Anya said Salma's been really low since the move. Haven't heard from Salma in weeks. Should ring her this weekend, no excuses.
